A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we introduce OpenDialKG: a new Open ended dialog KG parallel corpus with ground truth reference annotations for entities and KG paths, and propose DialKG Walker model, a new dialog generation model that can generate engaging and diverse responses with explainable KG paths.

we propose a new OpenDialKG corpus for studying conversational reasoning over knowledge graphs, and a novel DialKG Walker model for learning symbolic transitions of dialog context over KG and retrieving natural entities to introduce.
we propose a novel model for explainable conversational reasoning, which can generate natural responses and explain them with a KG path.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can learn to generate engaging and diverse dialog responses by learning to traverse through the large scale knowledge graphs.
a symbolic reasoning model can learn to generate engaging dialog responses with the help of a large scale KG.
a KG can be used as a common sense knowledge resource that can help to generate more human like and engaging responses for conversational agents.
